'''Benjamin Fadda''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2002 Ralltiir Regionals]] on 19 May 2002 with dark side combat, according to Vjeko Keskic's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3678">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2002-05-21-mainz-19-05-2002-regional-raltiird3678/ mainz-19-05-2002-regional-raltiir], DeckTech (Vjeko "mighty_maul" Keskic, 21 May 2002). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2002-05-21-mainz-19-05-2002-regional-raltiird3678/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
